text:
maria chen: Heads-up — product asked for a console affordance to let teams opt into v2 routing for a tenant-level gradual rollout. Want to discuss telemetry needs + quota implications.
samir patel: Sounds reasonable. Is this opt-in permanent or a scoped canary window? :thinking:
maria chen: Scoped canary preferred. UI toggle + backend flag. We want an easy rollback and visibility in Console.
chris oneil: We need telemetry to show % of requests hitting v2, latency P50/P95, and token cost delta vs v1 per-tenant. Also errors by model variant.
elaine-dev: Agree. Also surface sampling of request payloads (scrubbed) for quality regressions. Need a privacy checkbox for customers.
maria chen: For quota math: when tenant opts-in, do we account usage to the same quota bucket? That affects reserved capacity and billing.
samir patel: We should treat opt-in as routing preference only. Quotas remain per-customer usage regardless of backend model. But for Dedicated pools we may need capacity reservations if many tenants switch.
chris oneil: Implementation option: add a tenantRoutingPreference enum: {AUTO, OPT_IN_V2, OPT_OUT_V2}. Server routes by preference+policy. Fallback still to v1 on failure.
elaine-dev: UX question: do we expose percentage rollout slider (0-100) in Console or only an on/off + staged rollout API? Slider is nice but harder to represent in policy engine.
maria chen: Proposal: Console shows a slider for % traffic to v2, backed by a rollout policy object. Default 0. We store: rollout_policy = "canary:10,wait:24h,step:10" as string for now.
samir patel: For telemetry, we must emit these signals: route.version, route.decision_reason, route.fallback_type, rollout.percent_configured. Also include a sampling key so we can link request -> rollout config.
chris oneil: +1. Keep the event small. Example JSON log line we can emit:
```
{"route.version":"v2","decision":"match-optin","fallback":"none","rollout_pct":"10"}
```
maria chen: We need to ensure Console dashboard can compute a stable baseline for model quality. Suggest we store per-tenant evaluation sets and compute regression alerts when similarity drops > X.
elaine-dev: That ties into Optimize team work. For initial launch, basic metric: generation latency and error rate. Keep eval integration optional.
samir patel: Quota impact: if v2 is more expensive per-token, customers will get higher bills. We should add a Console warning when enabling if model unit cost delta > 10%.
chris oneil: Also provide an escape hatch: global kill-switch and per-tenant force-fallback to v1. Implemented via routing policy precedence (admin overrides tenant). We already have emergency_admin_flag in runtime.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollout-policy-service v1.3 promoted to staging at 3921002240 by ci/cd
maria chen: Nice. For audit: record who toggled the opt-in, timestamp, and config. Console should show history and allow revert to previous config.
elaine-dev: UX copy: "Enable v2 routing for a share of your traffic (can be rolled back at any time). Fallback to v1 on error unless disabled." Keep it simple.
samir patel: Sampling rate for payload logs: default 1% with option to increase for a tenant. Must be configurable and capped.
chris oneil: Engineering work items: runtime routing key, rollout config storage, telemetry events, console slider + history, billing warning. Estimate 3 sprints across infra+console+billing.
maria chen: OK let's action: Samir take runtime + telemetry schema. Chris and Elaine take Console UI + history. I'll coordinate with Billing to add the warning. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10am.
samir patel: I'll post the telemetry proto in #eng-platform after the sync. Thanks.
chris oneil: Thanks — will mock UI tomorrow.
elaine-dev: Copy. I'll draft the UX microcopy and mock screenshots.
maria chen: Great. Thanks team. :rocket:
